$comment: Screens and states the axe check visits (tests/e2e/features/accessibility.feature, one example per screen and state). {building} etc. (also in 'queries') are ids of records the check seeds itself. Every new or changed screen is added here; every state must be one of stateMeanings. 'empty' and 'first-use' run on the empty instance of the E2E stack, 'demo' on its demo instance (playwright.config.ts). Every state is checked light and dark (docs/archive/redesign/docs/archive/redesign/01-plan.md D4). A screen may override the query string of a state in 'queries'. A state with a second variant (the list scoped to a period as well as to a contract) gets a second screen whose 'default' is that variant (statements-period).

stateMeanings.default: The page as loaded with the seeded records.
stateMeanings.empty: A list with no records at all, on the empty instance of the E2E stack (second backend on an empty database).
stateMeanings.first-use: Overview without any building, on the empty instance of the E2E stack.
stateMeanings.filtered-empty: A list whose search matches nothing (?search=…).
stateMeanings.submit-empty: A new-record form submitted without input: all validation errors visible.
stateMeanings.register-preview: «Neues Gebäude» after choosing an address of the Gebäuderegister: the hints and the Wohnungen to check, some marked as missing in the register (#479).
stateMeanings.register-submit-missing: «Neues Gebäude» with the register's Wohnungen submitted while values the register lacks are still empty: their errors at the fields (#479).
stateMeanings.register-no-apartments: «Neues Gebäude» after choosing an address whose building has no Wohnungen in the register and is already entered in Dwello: both hints (#479).
stateMeanings.register-no-hit: «Neues Gebäude» with an address search the register finds nothing for (#479).
stateMeanings.register-unreachable: «Neues Gebäude» with an address search while the register cannot be reached (#479).
stateMeanings.advance-delete-dialog: Contract page of a contract with a later Akonto: the dialog confirming its deletion, with the Akonto that applies again (#464).
stateMeanings.advance-delete-refused: The delete dialog of a later Akonto refused because a draft statement counts it: the refusal in the dialog (#464).
stateMeanings.end-dialog-advance-refused: The end dialog refused because a later Akonto applies after the Vertragsende: the refusal names its day (#464).
stateMeanings.advance-from-missing: The contract form saved with a changed Akonto and an emptied «Gültig ab»: the error at the field (#464).
stateMeanings.advance-refused: The contract form saved with a new Akonto from a day a draft statement already bills: the refusal names the draft (#464).
stateMeanings.document-delete-dialog: The confirmation dialog for deleting a document the property manager uploaded to the tenant, open.
stateMeanings.upload-refused: A file Dwello does not take (a Word file) uploaded to the tenant: the refusal at the file field.
stateMeanings.upload-dialog: «Rechnungen hochladen» open with a building chosen, a PDF the KI stand-in read (deducted amounts, costs not allocable, an unsure Rechnungsdatum) opened for checking, and a refused Word file.
stateMeanings.upload-discard-dialog: «Rechnungen hochladen» with a file in it, cancelled: the confirmation that the files and entries are lost.
stateMeanings.upload-partial: «Rechnungen hochladen» after creating one of two invoices: the result naming the file still open, that file with its missing Kategorie, the button counting the incomplete one.
stateMeanings.upload-discard-created: «Rechnungen hochladen» after creating one of two invoices, cancelled: the confirmation that created invoices stay.
stateMeanings.upload-unreadable: «Rechnungen hochladen» with a file the KI answered nothing readable for: the row with its note and «Erneut versuchen».
stateMeanings.fuel-stock-dialog: Building page with a Tankbestand reading: the confirmation before deleting it open.
stateMeanings.end-dialog: The dialog that ends a rental contract open.
stateMeanings.end-dialog-error: The dialog that ends a rental contract confirmed without a Vertragsende: the error at the field.
stateMeanings.past-end-error: A Vertragsende before today (end dialog or contract form) saved without the confirmation: the checkbox with its error.
stateMeanings.delete-unconfirmed: The delete dialog of a rental contract that has started, confirmed without confirming it was entered by mistake: the checkbox with its error (#116).
stateMeanings.end-dialog-notice-hint: The end dialog with a Vertragsende less than 3 months after the day the notice arrived: the hint on the Kündigungsfrist at the field (A-3, #112).
stateMeanings.moved-out-dialog: Contract page of an expired fixed-term contract: the dialog that confirms «Mieter ist ausgezogen» with its consequence (A-6, #115).
stateMeanings.continue-refused: Contract page of an expired fixed-term contract: «Unbefristet weiterführen» refused because a draft statement bills the time after the end as Leerstand; the message, the link to the draft and the offer to delete it (A-6, #115).
stateMeanings.end-dialog-refused: The end dialog refused because a draft statement already bills later rent days: the link to the draft and the offer to delete it.
stateMeanings.edit-refused: The contract form saved with a Vertragsende before rent days a draft statement already bills: the refusal, the link to the draft and the offer to delete it.
stateMeanings.pdf-missing: Statement list of the seeded building's drafts, whose PDF is not created yet: each row says «PDF noch nicht erstellt» with a link to its statement (#253).
stateMeanings.list-scoped: List opened from a link that names a Mietvertrag or an Abrechnungsperiode: a sentence above the list says which statements it shows and links to all.
stateMeanings.link-preset: Statement wizard opened from a link that names a building and a period (after a changed Vertragsende): it starts at the settings step and says what the link chose.
stateMeanings.send-dialog: The confirmation before sending a statement open: marking it as sent for a letter, sending it by e-mail for a tenant who wants e-mail (#86).
stateMeanings.send-refused: A draft statement whose tenant wants e-mail but has no address, sent: it stays a draft, the alert says why and offers to deliver it by letter (#86).
stateMeanings.recalculate-dialog: Draft statement, «Neu berechnen» chosen (#338): the confirmation that names what stays and what changes.
stateMeanings.reminder-dialog: The Mahnung dialog of a sent statement open.
stateMeanings.marked-sent: A letter just marked as sent: the notice that offers its remade PDF to print (#193).
stateMeanings.mark-paid-dialog: The dialog that marks a statement as paid open.
stateMeanings.reset-payment-dialog: The dialog that resets the payment of a paid statement open (#92).
stateMeanings.correct-dialog: The confirmation before a sent or paid statement is replaced by a berichtigte Abrechnung open, with the amount it offsets and the limitation (#120).
stateMeanings.generation-result: «Abrechnungen erstellen» after creating the drafts of a year without invoices: how many were created, «Entwürfe ansehen», «Alle als ZIP herunterladen» (#356) and «Weitere Abrechnungen erstellen».
stateMeanings.action-error: A server action failed (deleting a sent statement, posted as from a stale tab, is refused): the error alert visible.
stateMeanings.every-wizard-step: Each step of the wizard in turn, up to the step before saving (the contract wizard's tenant has a contract without Vertragsende: its step «Wohnung» names it, #156).
stateMeanings.preview-empty: Statement wizard preview for a period without rental contracts.
stateMeanings.preview-skipped: Statement wizard preview of 2014 with a building whose only contract is billed outside Dwello up to 31.12.2014 («Abgerechnet bis»): the text that all its contracts are billed outside Dwello and the line with the link to the contract (#453).
stateMeanings.billed-until-refused: Contract form with «Abgerechnet bis» after today: the refusal at the field; in the wizard «Neuer Mietvertrag» at step «Vertragsdauer» with a Vertragsbeginn in the past, whose warning points to the field (#453).
stateMeanings.category-check: Statement wizard preview whose check per category reports invoices missing against the year before.
stateMeanings.invoice-hints: Statement wizard preview of a period under a year (January to May): the invoices without Leistungszeitraum that count in full, and one dated shortly after the period end, each with its edit link (#131, #134).
stateMeanings.period-not-over: Statement wizard with a period that has not ended yet: the warning in step 1 visible.
stateMeanings.preview-all-billed: Statement wizard preview of a period in which every contract already has a statement: how to recalculate and the links to the statements.
stateMeanings.preview-outdated: Statement wizard preview of a period whose existing statements include an outdated draft (a later invoice): named with its link and what changed (#132).
stateMeanings.agreed-costs-none: Contract form with every box of the agreed Nebenkosten unticked (#91): the note that the tenant is then billed no Nebenkosten (not saved).
stateMeanings.flat-rate-warning: Contract form at the step «Miete» with a Nebenkostenpauschale, no Akonto and ticked Nebenkosten (#429): the warning that Dwello still bills the ticked Nebenkosten (not saved).
stateMeanings.flat-rate-warning-advance: Contract form at the step «Miete» with an Akonto, a Nebenkostenpauschale and every Nebenkosten ticked (#432): the warning to leave ticked only the Nebenkosten with Akonto (not saved).
stateMeanings.agreed-costs-none-advance: Contract form at the step «Miete» with an Akonto and every Nebenkosten unticked (#444): the caution that Dwello bills no Nebenkosten and the Akonto is paid back (not saved).
stateMeanings.agreed-costs: Statement wizard at the settings step (#91): «Weiter» with the questions whether a category is agreed not answered (their errors), and the contract whose answered «nicht vereinbart» category has costs in the period.
stateMeanings.agreements-failed: Statement wizard at the settings step (#91) when whether the contracts agree the period's Nebenkosten cannot be checked (that request answers an error): the alert with «Erneut versuchen», and after «Weiter» the note that the wizard waits for the check (#439).
stateMeanings.agreement-save-failed: Statement wizard at the settings step (#91): an answer whether a category is agreed that could not be saved (the save answers an error): the question's error.
stateMeanings.tank-question: Statement wizard preview with a building that has heating costs but never had a Tankbestand: the question about a tank visible.
stateMeanings.overlap-warning: Rental contract wizard with a start date that overlaps another contract of the apartment.
stateMeanings.rent-taken-over: Rental contract wizard at the step «Miete» for an apartment with an earlier contract: its Nettomiete, Zusatzmiete and Akonto filled in, the note naming that contract (#144).
stateMeanings.contracts-unknown: Rental contract wizard or form whose apartments' rental contracts cannot be loaded (that request answered with an error): the hint at the apartment, in the form also at the start (#143), and the message after «Erneut versuchen» failed again (#151).
stateMeanings.contracts-unknown-review: Rental contract wizard at the step before saving, the apartment's rental contracts not loaded (that request answered with an error): the hint above the review (#143).
stateMeanings.draft-restored: A wizard reopened with input kept in the browser: notice «Angaben wiederhergestellt» (not saved yet, #57) and save status visible.
stateMeanings.missing-statements: Contract page of a contract with several ended Abrechnungsperioden without a statement (the seeded contract runs since 2015, statements only for 2024 and 2025): the warning with one button per period (#142) and a link to the building's invoices of each (#211).
stateMeanings.draft-discard-dialog: A wizard reopened with input kept in the browser, «Angaben verwerfen» clicked: the dialog asking before the input is deleted (#201).
stateMeanings.draft-dropped: Statement wizard reopened with input whose building and heating profile were deleted since: the restore notice says so (#135).
stateMeanings.old-address-preview: Statement wizard preview of 2024 with a tenant who moved out and still has the building's address: the warning at his row (A-5, #114).
stateMeanings.heating-hints: Statement wizard preview of 2024 with tenants who moved out and a Heizprofil: the heating invoices without Leistungszeitraum beside one with, each with its edit link (#339, #451).
stateMeanings.old-address-task: Overview with a draft statement of a tenant who moved out and still has the building's address: the task «Neue Adresse eintragen» (A-5, #114).
stateMeanings.buildings-billed: Statement wizard step «Gebäude» with a building whose rental contracts partly have a statement in the period: the count at the building (#135).
stateMeanings.buildings-overlap: Statement wizard step «Gebäude» with a period that overlaps the building's statement period without being equal: the building cannot be chosen, the text names the existing period and the ways out (#199, #408 point 2).
stateMeanings.formula-tested: Distribution key form after testing a formula.
stateMeanings.ki-proposal: New category form after «Von der KI prüfen lassen»: the KI's proposal with its reasoning, the choice preset (#176).
stateMeanings.ki-unsure: New category form after the KI was not sure: the hint to choose oneself, nothing preset (#176, #186).
stateMeanings.ki-unavailable: New category form after the KI could not be reached: the hint to try later or choose oneself, nothing preset (#186).
stateMeanings.ki-checking: New category form while the KI checks: the button busy, «Die KI prüft die Kategorie …» in the status region (#176, code review G-3).
stateMeanings.ki-proposal-kept: New category form where the Liegenschaftsverwalter chose before «Von der KI prüfen lassen»: the proposal says the own choice stays (#176, persona review).
stateMeanings.fuel-refused: Edit form of a fuel category with a Tankbestand after saving it without «Brennstoff»: the refusal says both checkboxes stay and how to remove them (#100).
stateMeanings.fuel: New category form with «Heizkosten nach dem Heizprofil verteilen» ticked: the checkbox «Brennstoff» with its help (#100).
stateMeanings.profile-sum-invalid: Heating profile form whose monthly shares do not add up to 100 %.
stateMeanings.login-error: Login page showing a sign-in error (?error=failed).
stateMeanings.login-not-allowed: Login page after an account outside ALLOWED_EMAILS was refused (?error=not_allowed, #51).
stateMeanings.mobile-menu-open: Navigation drawer open (mobile and tablet viewport).
stateMeanings.user-menu-open: User menu in the header open.
stateMeanings.dialog-open: A confirmation dialog of the page open.
stateMeanings.busy-dialog-open: A confirmation dialog open while its action is running.
stateMeanings.submit-cleared: An edit form with its required fields emptied and submitted: all validation errors visible.
stateMeanings.saved-toast: An edit form saved unchanged: the success message (toast) visible on the page it leads to.
stateMeanings.server-error: The error page for a failed load (not 404): message and the hint to try again.
stateMeanings.other-language: The page in French, chosen with the language selection (it reloads in French).
stateMeanings.language-menu-open: The language menu in the header open.
stateMeanings.demo: The page on the demo instance of the E2E stack (DEMO=on): the demo notice at the top of the page; on the privacy statement and the terms also their section on the demo.
